title.narrative: New support to the Bolivia electoral authority 2020

description.narrative: State institutions have designed and implemented efficient and effective policies that promote non-violent coexistence with equitable access to quality justice, citizen security and sectoral public services, with permanent dialogue and the effective participation of a more qualified civil society

Projektet syftar till stödja en inledningsfas till valprocessen i Bolivia som kommer att äga rum april 2020. Övergångsregeringen, sociala och politiska aktörer är även överens om behovet av att delta i en nationell dialog med stöd av det internationella samfundet i Bolivia. Stödet kommer att fokusera på tre faser: (i) förberedelsefasen, (ii) genomförandefas (administration av vallagen) och (iii) fas efter valet (preliminär rösträkning och resultat av valet). Följande schema sammanfattar aktiviteterna under respektive fas:
1. Identifiering av FN / UNDP Bolivia-bidrag i en inledningsfas till valprocessen 2020 1.1 Utnämning av medlemmar av den nya valmyndigheten (OEP med dess spanska förkortning) 1.2 Uppdatera valregistret. 1.3 Aktivt deltagande av urbefolknings grupper i valprocessen.
2. Utveckling av valprocessen. 2.1 Främja en samhällsplattform för valövervakning. (ungdomar, samhällsplattformar och urbefolkningsgrupper) 2.2 Stöd för registrering och spridning av snabb omröstnings resultat (TREP med dess spanska förkortning).
3.Legitimering av den slutliga beräkningen och av den nya valmyndigheten (OEP) 3.1 Producera material om transparens in för valprocessen. 3.2 Starta valmyndighetens kapacitets byggandeprogram.
UNDPs konkreta bidrag kommer att bestå av tekniskt stöd genom internationella experter som kommer att stödja den bolivianska valmyndigheten inför valet 2020. Insatsen också kan användas för "emergency procurment"/nödvändig upphandling av material till TED.

The transitional government, political and social actors all agree on the need to take part in a national dialogue, with the support of the international community in Bolivia, with a view to supporting the three stages of the electoral process: (i) preparation phase (call for elections, electoral calendar), (ii) implementation phase (administration of the electoral act) and (iii) post-elections phase (preliminary vote count and delivery of final vote count/results). The following scheme summarizes these phases:
1.Identification of UN/UNDP Bolivia contributions in an inception phase to the electoral 2020 process 1.1 Appointment of members OEP. 1.2 Update the electoral register. 1.3 Active participation of PIOCs in the electoral process.
2.Development of the electoral process. 2.1 Promote a society platform for electoral oversight. (youth, society platforms and indigenous peoples) 2.2 Support the registration and dissemination of TREP results
3.Legitimacy of the final computation and OEP Institutionality 3.1Produce municipal materials and content about transparency and suitability of the electoral process. 3.2 Start an OEP strengthening program.

Output or component 1: Technical assistance: Greater efficiency, capacity and transparency of electoral management and administration through technical assistance and advice. Support and advice to the TSE in strategic management and decision-making and, at a technical level, in the areas of civil registration and voter database management, electoral operations, transmission of results, and capacity building. Summary of the results obtained: • Until December 2020, the Project had a stable, balanced and correctly distributed work team. It had 24 plant officials hired, ensuring an effective presence in the 10 electoral tribunals that make up the OEP. In addition to electoral generalists, the Project has placed specialists in electoral justice, electoral operations, information technology, gender, and other fields, at the complete and exclusive disposal of the Bolivian electoral authorities. • Based on the work of its permanent staff, the Project covered the 10 electoral courts that make up the OEP, remotely, due to the pandemic, and in person, when the health emergency allowed it. Since the beginning of the Project, in February 2020, formal and informal diagnoses and evaluations have been conducted, in relation to the capacities of these instances in order to determine pressing needs and better calibrate support points and collaboration spaces. . • The Project made available to the OEP the work and experience of an international specialist in electoral communications, as well as a national consultant in management and media management. Both experts, at different times, agreed and made comments on the national communication strategy of the TSE and most of the TEDs. • The Project contracted more than 70 consultants, national and international, for and at the request of different functional areas of the TSE and the TEDs to cover critical gaps. • The Project also participated in and/or facilitated the organization and execution of more than 20 training events, at different levels, with different actors. Not only have the necessary spaces and supplies been financed to enable the training of national and departmental electoral authorities, judges, notaries and electoral juries, members of the press and political organizations, but also an active role has been assumed in terms of the preparation of operational, methodological and thematic plans for these purposes. • The Project supported the OEP in the production of multiple television spots and radio spots. It also helped to print information brochures for different actors, often in indigenous languages.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
